Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

datacaged 0.2.32026-10-12

Message language

  • All console messages (errors, warnings, progress) are now written in English in the source code and translated to Brazilian Portuguese through the standard R/gettext mechanism. Users with R set to Portuguese see them in Portuguese automatically; Sys.setLanguage("pt_BR") or Sys.setLanguage("en") switches the language within a session. Previously the messages mixed both languages and the shipped translations were never applied, because the cli calls did not go through gettext().
  • The translation catalog now contains only R-pt_BR.po; R-en.po was removed because the source language is English.
  • The tests run in English regardless of the machine’s locale, and a new test checks that every translation keeps the {...} code blocks of the original message unchanged.

Bug fixes

  • Messages such as “20 registro inserido” now use the correct plural (“20 records inserted” / “20 registros inseridos”): the count was formatted as text before reaching cli, which then always used the singular.

datacaged 0.2.2

Bug fixes

  • Fixed test failures on CRAN with duckdb >= 1.5, which caches database instances per file and refuses read_only = TRUE when an instance for the same path is already open (read_only can't be applied to the database instance ... which already exists):
    • caged_load() and caged_adjustments_load() now close their write connection before calling caged_info().
    • The internal .disconnect() helper now also calls duckdb::duckdb_shutdown(), since dbDisconnect(shutdown = TRUE) no longer releases the cached instance.
    • caged_info(), caged_to_parquet() and caged_update() reuse an already-open instance (e.g. a user connection) instead of failing.
  • Data loss in caged_for and caged_exc: the deduplication key competencia was taken from competenciamov, but FOR/EXC files contain movements from earlier months that repeat across files, so loading month t+1 silently skipped rows whose competenciamov had already appeared (e.g. 46% of CAGEDFOR202303). The key is now competenciadec for caged_for and competenciaexc for caged_exc (one value per file). caged_mov, caged_antigo and caged_ajustes are unchanged. Action required: databases built with earlier versions should drop caged_for and caged_exc and reload them with caged_load(). Use competenciamov for analyses by month of movement.
  • Fixed column-name normalization when the package is installed or run in a non-UTF-8 locale (e.g. C/POSIX): accented headers such as competênciamov became compet_nciamov, and caged_to_duckdb() aborted with “Nenhuma coluna de competencia encontrada”. .normalize_names() now uses chartr() and read_delim() uses name_repair = "unique_quiet".

Behaviour changes

  • caged_download_layouts() now downloads the layout files from the HuggingFace repository instead of the MTE FTP server, which was slow and often unreachable. Local file names have accents removed; the original name is kept in the arquivo column.
  • caged_update() now compares competencies table by table instead of using the maximum competency. It also fills gaps inside the period already in the database (e.g. a FOR file whose download failed) and calls the pipeline once per year, so it no longer downloads unneeded months (requesting 202512 and 202601 used to also download 202501 and 202612).
  • Year validation now matches the data available on HuggingFace: legacy CAGED from 2007 (caged_load(), caged_download()) and CAGED Adjustments from 2002 (caged_adjustments_load()). Earlier years now fail immediately with a clear message instead of finding no files.

More bug fixes

  • caged_to_duckdb(overwrite_competencies = TRUE) now runs DELETE and INSERT in a single transaction: if the insert fails, the previous data is kept.
  • Errors while checking which competencies are already stored are no longer swallowed (they used to be treated as “none stored”, duplicating rows).
  • caged_to_parquet(): partition_by accepts several columns, overwrite = FALSE is respected for partitioned output, a missing partition column gives a clear warning, and paths containing ' work. Partition directories for code columns (competencies, uf, regiao, municipio) are now named competencia=202301/uf=35 instead of competencia=202301.0/uf=35.0; the cast to integer happens only in the export, so the database schema is unchanged.
  • caged_adjustments_load() for 2002-2009, where the source is one annual file per year: the file is now downloaded and parsed once instead of once per requested month (about 6x faster for a full year), and only the requested months are stored (previously the whole year was stored).
  • Downloads are written to a temporary .part file and renamed when complete, so an interrupted write can no longer leave a truncated file that the cache would treat as valid.
  • The internal HuggingFace listing no longer fails under a non-UTF-8 locale for file names with accents.
  • caged_hf_files(verbose = FALSE) no longer prints the “Querying HuggingFace” message.

Tests

  • No test accesses the network on CRAN anymore: the layouts test and the sequential download test are mocked; real-network tests use skip_on_cran() and skip_if_offline().
  • Fixed mocks leaking across test files: on.exit() without add = TRUE after local_mocked_bindings() discarded the restore handler.

Documentation

  • Corrected data coverage: legacy CAGED is available from 2007 and CAGED Adjustments from 2002 (previously documented as 1992).
  • caged_to_duckdb() documentation now describes the actual deduplication mechanism and the key column per table (it never used INSERT OR IGNORE).
  • ?datacaged now lists caged_update(), caged_to_parquet() and caged_download_layouts().
  • inst/CITATION now reads the version from DESCRIPTION.
  • Updated caged_info() sample output in the vignettes.

datacaged 0.2.12026-09-09

Breaking changes

  • caged_ftp_files() removed — use caged_hf_files() instead.

Bug fixes

  • Fixed caged_hf_files(type = "ajustes") returning years > 2019 — now correctly filters to years <= 2019.
  • Fixed CAGED Adjustments file name pattern (CAGEDEST_AJUSTES_ was incorrectly read as CAGEDAJUSTES_); updated prefixo_len from 13 to 17.
  • Added support for CAGED_AJUSTES/2002a2009/ folder (annual files CAGEDEST_AJUSTES_AAAA.7z).
  • Fixed .insert_rows() to handle schema evolution when loading data from multiple years with different column sets (ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN).
  • Converted \donttest{} examples that require network access or a populated database to \dontrun{} to pass R CMD check --run-donttest.
  • Fixed duplicate caged_ftp_files alias in documentation.
  • Removed U+FE0F variation selector from source files (LaTeX PDF error).
  • Updated CI workflows: added concurrency, CI=true, reduced coverage timeout to 15 min, added dependabot.yml.
  • Replaced absolute file paths in examples (~/Downloads/, D:/dados/) with portable alternatives (file.path(tempdir(), ...), file.path("~", ...)).

datacaged 0.2.0

Breaking changes

  • Source migrated from FTP do MTE (ftp://ftp.mtps.gov.br/pdet/microdados/) to HuggingFace dataset (https://huggingface.co/datasets/alexsandroprado/caged). Downloads now use HTTPS — no more FTP port 21 issues behind firewalls.

New functions

  • caged_hf_files(): replaces caged_ftp_files() — lists available competencies from the HuggingFace repository via its REST API.
  • caged_update(): incremental update — downloads only competencies not yet in the local DuckDB bank, querying the bank max competência and HuggingFace availability.
  • caged_to_parquet(): exports DuckDB tables to Parquet files using DuckDB’s native COPY TO ... (FORMAT PARQUET) — supports optional column partitioning. — lists available competencies from the HuggingFace repository via its REST API.

Deprecated

  • caged_ftp_files(): kept as an alias with a deprecation warning. Will be removed in a future version. Use caged_hf_files() instead.

Internal changes

  • download.R: .ftp_url() renamed to .hf_url(); .download_file() now uses method = "libcurl" with HTTPS and --location to follow CDN redirects.

  • availability.R: .ftp_list() renamed to .hf_list_dir(); uses httr2 instead of curl FTP listing.

  • status.R: caged_status() now checks HuggingFace API endpoint.

  • Added httr2 (>= 1.0.0) to Imports. # datacaged 0.1.2

  • DESCRIPTION: URL do FTP do MTE adicionada ao campo Description: conforme política do CRAN.

  • man/*.Rd: \dontrun{} substituído por \donttest{} em todos os exemplos — os exemplos requerem internet mas podem ser executados pelo usuário.

  • man/*.Rd: db_path = "caged.duckdb" substituído por db_path = file.path(tempdir(), "caged.duckdb") em todos os exemplos para evitar escrita no diretório de trabalho do usuário. # datacaged 0.1.1

  • DESCRIPTION: 'DuckDB' entre aspas simples em Title e Description conforme política do CRAN. # datacaged 0.1.0

Primeira versão do pacote — submetida ao CRAN.

Funções exportadas

  • caged_load() — pipeline completo: download → parse → DuckDB (Novo CAGED e antigo).
  • caged_download() — baixa arquivos .7z do FTP do MTE com cache local e retry automático.
  • caged_parse() — lê e normaliza microdados de um arquivo .7z.
  • caged_parse_batch() — versão vetorizada de caged_parse() com barra de progresso.
  • caged_to_duckdb() — grava dados no DuckDB com controle de duplicatas por competência.
  • caged_connect() — abre conexão DBI com o banco DuckDB.
  • caged_info() — exibe estatísticas das tabelas no banco.
  • caged_adjustments_load() — pipeline completo para o CAGED Ajustes.
  • caged_status() — verifica disponibilidade do servidor FTP do MTE.
  • caged_ftp_files() — lista competências disponíveis no FTP.
  • caged_download_layouts() — baixa os layouts oficiais do MTE.
  • Dataset uf_codigos — tabela de UFs com códigos IBGE e regiões.
